properties.description: Beautycounter is a mission-driven personal care company focused on setting new standards for the beauty industry through rigorous ingredient safety testing. By strictly avoiding a defined 'Never List' of harmful chemicals, the brand provides high-performance, luxury-quality skincare and cosmetics designed for modern, health-conscious consumers. Its business model combines direct sales with community-based advocacy, empowering consumers to push for better safety regulations in personal care. The brand is recognized for merging beauty efficacy with a deeply embedded commitment to human and environmental wellness.
